source: JLCPCB 2-layer standard service, published PCB capabilities (fetched 2026-08-08): https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities . Quoted values -- 'Min. track width and spacing (1 oz): 0.10 / 0.10 mm (4 / 4 mil)'; 'Drill Diameter: 0.15 - 6.3 mm'; 'Min. Via hole size/diameter: 0.15mm / 0.25mm'; 'PTH annular ring (1 oz): recommended 0.25 mm or above, absolute minimum 0.18 mm'; 'Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing: 0.45mm' and 'Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing: 0.2mm'; solder mask 'Min. pad spacing: 0.10 mm (green, red, yellow, blue, purple)'; 'Soldermask Expansion: 1:1'; copper clearance to routed board edge '>= 0.2 mm'; 'PTH to Track: 0.28mm'; through-hole size tolerance '+0.13 / -0.08 mm'. Field-level notes: min_finished_hole_mm reuses the published minimum via HOLE SIZE (0.15; the corresponding minimum via land diameter is 0.25) -- JLCPCB states hole size tolerance rather than a separate finished-hole floor, and reusing the closest published figure follows the oshpark-2layer precedent of never inventing a number. min_hole_to_hole_mm takes the PAD hole-to-hole figure (0.45) rather than the looser via-to-via figure (0.2) because the schema carries ONE hole-to-hole floor; the coarseness is resolved in the fail-closed direction (a via chain legal at JLCPCB may be refused; a pad-hole pair the fab would flag never passes). min_annular_ring_mm records the published ABSOLUTE minimum (0.18); the 0.25 recommendation is quoted above for authors who want margin. solder_mask_clearance_mm (0.05) is OUR emission-side mask-opening allowance, not a JLCPCB figure: JLCPCB plots solder mask 1:1 and publishes no expansion of its own, so the fabricated opening equals whatever the Gerbers carry; 0.05 mm keeps the v1-fab-conservative allowance so mask apertures do not collapse to exact pad size. solder_mask_expansion_mm 0.0 records the published 1:1 rule verbatim (the fab adds nothing). min_annular_ring_mm carries the same single-field coarseness as hole-to-hole, resolved the same fail-closed way: JLCPCB's published minimum via (hole 0.15 / diameter 0.25) implies a 0.05 via ring, but the schema carries ONE annular floor, so the PTH absolute minimum (0.18) governs and a tighter via JLCPCB would accept is refused conservatively. ENFORCEMENT SCOPE of min_hole_to_copper_mm (0.28, quoted from 'PTH to Track: 0.35mm recommended, minimum 0.28mm'): today the only reader is the zone-fill pour carve (zone_fill.py) — no geometric check enforces hole-to-TRACK distance, so the rule is honoured for pours and DECLARED-BUT-UNENFORCED for tracks (filed: docket hole-to-track gap; same class as the hole-to-edge gap 019fe3286237). FIELD-SEMANTICS NOTE on solder_mask_expansion_mm: this profile records the FAB-APPLIED expansion (0.0 — JLCPCB plots 1:1, adding nothing), whereas oshpark-2layer.json's 0.0508 records OSH Park's recommended AUTHORING-side KiCad expansion; the field currently has no functional reader, and the divergence is stated here rather than silently carried until a reader arrives.
